situation.estimate: Stealth exit on 11 Nov 2026 (founded Nov 2025 by four ex-Microsoft Kusto/Azure Data Explorer leaders), $25M seed (Sequoia) + $45M Series A (Quiet Capital) at a reported $500M valuation. ~40 people, mostly engineering, Tel Aviv + San Francisco, with Fortune 500 design partners in production at petabyte scale. Now turning from invite-only to market: usage-based pricing page live, account-setup flow, AWS re:Invent booth #458 (30 Nov) and Google Cloud Next '27 planned. GTM is founder- and agency-led so far; hiring a marketing leader and building content is the likely next step. Category positioning is 'unified data platform for search, analytics and AI agents' against Snowflake, Databricks, ClickHouse (and implicitly Elastic/Kusto).
